missedcalltextback.friendlyProblem: A potential customer calls your business after hours but nobody picks up — the lead is lost forever.
missedcalltextback.friendlyGoal: Detect the missed call within 3 seconds, identify the caller, compose a personalized SMS, send it instantly, log the interaction, and schedule a follow-up callback.
missedcalltextback.friendlyTakeaway: Businesses lose 62% of callers who reach voicemail. An autonomous text-back agent recovers those leads instantly — no human intervention needed, 24/7/365.

nodes.name: Missed Call Detector
nodes.friendlyDesc: Catches the incoming call-drop webhook event from the telephony provider the instant a call goes unanswered or hits overflow.

nodes.name: Caller ID Resolver
nodes.friendlyDesc: Resolves the phone number to a name, company, and existing CRM record so the response feels personal, not robotic.

nodes.name: Voicemail Analyzer
nodes.friendlyDesc: Transcribes and classifies any voicemail left behind to understand what the caller actually wanted.

nodes.name: SMS Composer
nodes.friendlyDesc: Writes a warm, personalized SMS response using the caller's name and reason for calling — not a generic template.

nodes.name: SMS Dispatcher
nodes.friendlyDesc: Fires the personalized SMS through the carrier API so the caller gets a response before they even put their phone down.

nodes.name: Callback Scheduler
nodes.friendlyDesc: Finds the next available rep and books a callback slot on their calendar so no lead falls through the cracks.

nodes.name: CRM Logger
nodes.friendlyDesc: Creates a complete CRM entry: missed call timestamp, SMS sent, callback scheduled, and voicemail transcript attached.

nodes.name: Recovery Attestation
nodes.friendlyDesc: Stamps a tamper-proof audit record proving the entire recovery chain completed in under 3 seconds for compliance.
